refusal.when: nonfinite executed state or derivative, overflowing cotangent accumulation, singular denominator, invalid topology, or forward invalid flag; any nonzero device slot refuses the whole gradient
refusal.cleared_by: scheduler before every launch; inspect after sync

artifact_build.floating_point: --fmad=false --ftz=false; guarded forward arithmetic reproduced with IEEE operations

alias_policy: Forward allocation aliases follow the capture. Derivative buffers for aliased fields mirror those aliases; tangent, cotangent and failure storage are otherwise disjoint.

launch_abi.compatibility: Device refusal entries use distinct int32 slots and source IDs. The adjoint scans captured cells_on_edge in ascending edge order; it needs no derived buffers.

branch_record_status: Both derivative entries record the executed primal predicates as deterministic uint32 arm counts; the interim Taylor harness compares records at base and perturbed states.
cotangent_accumulation: When an input has multiple contributions, sum them in a fixed order in float64 and round once on the float32 accumulate; reductions use a fixed tree.
topology_transpose: Fixed-order scan of the captured cells_on_edge array, with a bounded local incidence cache and an unrestricted scan fallback for cells with more than 32 incident edges.
failure_attribution: Each independent existing refusal predicate has its own int32 slot and source ID, in evaluation order; any nonzero slot rejects the entire gradient.

seed_consumption.after_reverse: exact +0.0; slots outside the forward overwrite mask are bitwise unchanged
seed_consumption.coordination: zero-initialized per-launch completion counter; last block clears only after every block has finished its seed reads; device-scoped acquire/release counter orders all blocks before clearing
